summary: This paper delivers an extraordinary non-asymptotic refinement of Khanna, Putterman, and Song's linear-time deterministic MST framework, replacing hidden asymptotic constants with explicit, zero-float rational bounds and constructive Lean 4 proofs. By exposing a hidden factorial polylogarithmic blowup in polynomial schedules and introducing a stable geometric-horizon parameterization, the work achieves a concrete comparison bound of T*(m, n) <= 944 m.
strengths: Rigorous exact combinatorial sharpenings of bad-round ceilings, greedy portal bounds, and Fredman maxima-vector extremes.
Discovery and formal proof of the factorial polylogarithmic blowup in polynomial depth schedules.
Introduction and stability analysis of the geometric-horizon schedule achieving closed-form rational bounds.
Comprehensive machine-checked Lean 4.36.0 proofs and zero-float Python rational certificates.
weaknesses: The explicit constant C_geom remains large despite the massive multiplicative reduction.
Heavy reliance on complex multi-parameter optimization over rational grids.
